Let $c>0$ be the constant of Proposition Restim. Fix $0<\overline\delta _0<1/4$ so that $C^{[1/\overline\delta _0]}$-closeness to the standard initial metric implies $|R_{g'}-R_{g_0}|<c/2$ and $|\Ric _{g'}-\Ric _{g_0}|<1/4$.

Proposition
[Paths of bounded energy near a surgery cap have long integral length]
